Synopsis:
Nubank is entering the US market via a partner-bank model (Lead Bank, FDIC-insured), launching high-yield savings (3.50% APY), no-fee credit cards (1.5% cashback), and free remittances. Full banking operations pending Fed/FDIC approval of its OCC-conditionally-approved charter, expected in 2026. Target demographics are young digital-native users and the US Hispanic population. Profitability in the US is a multi-year horizon. Future products may include crypto trading, investments, insurance, and SMB accounts. US expansion strategy is primarily organic, with M&A optionality.
